title: Idle Galaxy
description: Idle Galaxy is a relaxing idle clicker game. Though, it's challenging enough so you won't get bored. Unlike other idle games, you can fully complete this one and it won't take all your life to accomplish this.GameplayTwo game modes with different goals. Complete 20 main levels and then realize that your journey has just begun.Upgrades12 unique upgrades for you to buy. No useless items. Each one will help you to complete the game.Perks100 various perks in stock to make you even stronger. Bought them all? Reset perks saving all your progress and making them available for purchase again with slightly increased price.RelaxationFancy graphics and meditative ambient music will make your journey even more comfortable. Just relax while you are playing this game.Achievements25 various achievements to track your progress. Will you be able to collect them all?GraphicsWell, it's just simple but beautiful.MiscellaneousPhoto mode to take beautiful screenshots. Runs in background so you can spend time for something else while it plays itself. Nothing unnecessary, just a pure gameplay.Immerse yourself in the amazing atmosphere of this game and you won't be disappointed.
description_short: Relaxing idle clicker game with various gameplay features. Challenging enough for hardcore players but it also can be fully completed.
